leads._about: How an end runs inside its clamp, from the belt's tip to where it joins the run: points and bend circles in the belt plane (mm), riding on `node`. Front: out of the bottom of the toy mount head, up between the tightener and the head, round the bend into the slot towards the rail.

rear._about: The back stop's channel mirrors the front one (measured the same way).
